# The XOR decryption loop:
# edx starts at 0x26 (38)
# For each byte i from 0 to 22:
#   plaintext[i] XOR edx == encrypted[i]
#   then edx += plaintext[i]
# So: plaintext[i] = encrypted[i] XOR edx
#   then edx += plaintext[i]

encrypted = bytes([
    0x60, 0x20, 0xf9, 0xbe, 0x3b, 0xd8, 0x7b, 0xe7,
    0x86, 0x3a, 0xe5, 0x71, 0xe0, 0x90, 0x36, 0xd9,
    0x57, 0xc8, 0xc5, 0x1e, 0x57, 0xa7, 0xba
])

edx = 0x26  # 38
plaintext = []
for i in range(23):
    p = encrypted[i] ^ (edx & 0xff)
    plaintext.append(p)
    edx = (edx + p) & 0xffffffff

result = bytes(plaintext)
print("Decrypted:", result)
print("Decrypted as string:", result.decode('latin-1'))
